title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study Q)
description: Study Q of the bigP3BCI collection, a large open P300-based brain-computer interface speller dataset. It contains 32-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz with a g.USBamp amplifier from 36 participants with ALS across three sessions each. Participants used a 6x6 character grid with color intensification, and target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags. The data are formatted for machine learning and benchmarking with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier from 32 channels placed in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz. Participants performed a P300 speller task on a 6x6 character grid with color intensification. Each participant completed three sessions, and online feedback was provided. Epochs were extracted over a 0-1.0 s interval after each stimulus for target versus non-target classification.
